Document: - 1. As an antagonist, you may eliminate Security personnel if they pose an active threat to you, but killing Security personnel “just in case” does not qualify. - 2. If you do not want to play an antagonist or suddenly need to leave in the middle of a round, use Ahelp(F1) so somebody else can be assigned to your role. - 3. If you use explosives to accomplish your objective, use only as many bombs as necessary: if you detonate a Syndicate bomb to breach a single wall, you will receive a ban in addition to destroying the compartment.
